data.acceptance:
1. Exact legacy, canonical/control/archive, and knots-inbox patterns have separate active rulesets; Actions integration 15368 is the sole canonical and freeze bypass actor.
2. Repository write, maintain, and admin roles cannot bypass Knots data-ref rules.
3. Inbox refs allow creation and fast-forward updates while denying deletion and non-fast-forward updates; canonical and archive refs deny direct client writes.
4. A trusted default-branch workflow validates inbox data and advances canonical state without checking out or executing inbox code.
5. Disposable-ref canaries prove ordinary-client rejection, Actions success, and safe recovery before any production Knots ref is frozen.
